item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
新功能

  • SystemAction: 手柄按钮可映射系统动作（Move to Space Left/Right、Mission Control、Launchpad、Notification Center、Show Desktop）
  • 手柄接管实时开关（Takeover ⇄ Gamepad Mode）

体验改进

  • 隐藏 App 列表 UI，所有手柄统一使用 default 配置
  • KeyConfig 弹窗：Detail 模式 key 改为录入式；新增 System tab
  • 摇杆模拟鼠标：120Hz 节流避免高 polling rate 设备速度过快；speed 改为滑块输入

修复

  • 首次配置 KeyMap 后手柄无响应
  • splitView 左栏仍可被拖出
  • Simple 模式录入方向键 + 修饰键的写回路径
  • switchApp 残留 AppConfig 数据导致 stick speed 间歇性被覆盖

Download the DMG and drag AgentPad to /Applications. On first launch: right-click → Open. Grant Accessibility permission when prompted.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
v1.2.0

Added

  • Gamepad Mode global toggle: A new NSSwitch at the top of the status bar
    menu lets you flip between "Takeover" (key remapping active) and
    "Gamepad Mode" (controller passes straight through to games) in one click.
  • Import / export key mappings: In Settings → Controllers you can now
    export a controller's default key map to JSON, or import one from a file.
    Cross-model imports (e.g. SNES layout into an Xbox) run in a lenient mode
    that silently drops buttons the target controller does not have.
  • Vector icons for extended gamepads: Xbox, DualSense and generic
    extended gamepads no longer fall back to the placeholder image — they now
    render as vector artwork with per-family colours (Xbox dark, DualSense
    white, generic mid-grey).

Fixed

  • No more ghost Xbox controllers: Reconnecting the same Xbox / DualSense
    used to create a fresh ControllerData row each time, and the Controllers
    list piled them up. The identifier is now derived from
    `(product category, vendor)` and is stable across sessions. A one-shot
    migration merges any legacy duplicates, keeping the row with the most
    configured key mappings.
  • Key map table renders when Xbox is disconnected: Selecting a
    disconnected Xbox in Settings → Controllers now shows its saved mappings
    instead of an empty table.
  • Settings window resizes with the selected tab: Switching from Agent
    Monitor to Controllers no longer clips the button list.
  • Status bar menu recognises non-JoyCon controllers: The connected
    controller rows now include Xbox / DualSense, not just Joy-Cons.

Improved

  • Menu bar and system options consolidated in the General tab: Launch at
    Login, automatic update checks, and the status badge toggle moved out of
    the Agent Monitor tab.
  • Removed the dead "Show count in menu bar" toggle, which never had an
    effect.
  • Trimmed the per-controller right-click menu: The redundant
    "Use as Gamepad" (replaced by the global switch) and the half-working
    "Enable key mappings" (only gated release/stick events) are gone.
    "Disconnect" is hidden for system-managed controllers where it was a
    no-op anyway.
